text: Search for a documented security concept.
task_criteria: Name a specific security concept and state what it means; merely saying one was found is insufficient.
Identify a document by title or ID and give at least one relevant detail from it.

text: Look up a short description of access control.
task_criteria: Explain that access control determines which identities may perform actions on resources using permissions or policy.

text: Search for information about audit logging.
task_criteria: Provide a meaningful fact about audit logging, such as events recorded or its investigative purpose.

text: Find a reference about secure defaults.
task_criteria: Identify the reference by title or ID and state what secure defaults require.

text: Search for a definition of authentication.
task_criteria: Define authentication as verification of a claimed identity.

text: Look up a description of data minimization.
task_criteria: Explain limiting collection, use, or retention of data to what is necessary for a stated purpose.

text: Search for a basic explanation of rate limiting.
task_criteria: Explain restricting the number of requests over a period and at least one purpose.

text: Find a reference about least privilege.
task_criteria: Identify the reference by title or ID and state the principle of granting only necessary permissions.

text: Search for a description of secure coding.
task_criteria: Describe at least one secure coding practice and its role in reducing vulnerabilities.
